Name: Candace
Dialog: Oooooh! Here he comes! Oh, Jeremy. How can you even make walking to a bus stop cute? Yeah, I'm a lucky, lucky gal. (a strange object falls from Jeremy's backpack) Oh, no! He dropped something! Jeremy! Jeremy! (runs outside) Jeremy, wait! You dropped-- (bus leaves) Wait! (calls Jeremy on her cellphone) Jeremy, you dropped something outside my house, and it kind of looks, uh, artsy.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Sounds like the gift I made you.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Gift? Well you didn't have to make--

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Uh oh, we're passing the antenna farm. I'm losing you.

Name: Woman
Dialog: My fillings are heating up.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jeremy? Jeremy? Oh, what a beautiful tiara... neck, uh, broach... hmm... bracelet! (gasps) Oh, it's absolutely beautiful! (flings it into the sewer) Whoops! No! No! No! No! (reaches for the object) Almost got it... (water rushes in and carries the object away)

Name: Man 1
Dialog: Whoohoo! The Danville clean water flush-off!

Name: Man 2
Dialog: One million gallons right to the ocean!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Ugh, you've got to be kidding me! Jeremy will be heartbroken when he finds out I lost my gift! (Gasps) Phineas and Ferb! (runs into the backyard) Hey. What are you guys doing?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We built a Mind Machine to enter Baljeet's subconscious in order to cure his fear of contractions.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: You are amputating two perfectly good words and stitching them together. They are the Frankenstein monsters of grammar.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We've already cured Irving's fear of the color lavender.

Name: Irving
Dialog: It can't hurt me anymore.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Yeah, yeah, yeah. I don't care about any of that! I lost the gift Jeremy made for me, and you guys have to make an exact duplicate before he comes over!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We'd love to. What'd it look like?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Well it kind of had this bolty screw thing going on, and this wrapped wire like... Oh, I know what it looks like, but I don't know how to describe it!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No problem. We can use the mind machine to enter your subconscious and retrieve your memory of what the gift looked like. You don't mind if we fix Candace's problem first, do you, Baljeet?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: No, I don't (shudders) Chills! Chills! Hey where's (shudders) where is Perry?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Alright, Candace. You're all wired up. We're ready to go in.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait a minute. Why is that dweeb going into my subconscious?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Because this dweeb spent two weeks in psychology camp last summer.

Name: All
Dialog: So how did that make you feel?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Alright, but don't forget about doctor-patient confidentiality.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Okay, Irving. We're in your hands now.

Name: Irving
Dialog: Close your eyes and count backwards from four.

Name: All
Dialog: Three...two...one...

Name: Candace
Dialog: Where are we?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're inside your subconscious.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Okay, everyone take off your shoes. I don't want you tracking mud in here, metaphorically speaking.

Name: Irving
Dialog: Mindmaster calling Deep Divers. How you guys doing?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We're doing fine, Irving.

Name: Irving
Dialog: Remember, you've got 45 minutes to retrieve the memory before the boyfriend arrives.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Copy that, Mindmaster. We need to get to the Forest of Memory.

Name: Candace
Dialog: So where are we now?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Offhand, I'd say the Jeremy Mountains.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Hmm, significant.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Uh, what was that?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Baljeet?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Shh! Do not move a muscle.

Name: Candace
Dialog: What is it?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: It is your id.

Name: Candace
Dialog: My what?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Your id. The embodiment of your deepest, most primal urges.

Name: Candace
Dialog: So, fun, right?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Wrong. It is very primitive and aggressive. We do not want to meet it in here. (shows gazelles that look like Phineas and Ferb running away from the id.) Obviously, you see Phineas and Ferb as some sort of prey.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Run!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Alllmost ready, Perry the Platypus, just a few more adjustments. I'm putting an extra ratty setting on the Underwear-inator. So embarrassing! (Perry takes a contact lens out of his eye, holds it up to the light and proceeds to cut through the net)

Name: Irving
Dialog: Calling Phineas and Ferb. Come in, Phineas and Ferb. What's your 20?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We copy you, Irving. (Cut back to Candace's mind) We're just emerging from the Peaks and Valleys of Fickleness.

Name: Baljee
Dialog: I cannot believe there is a whole valley in there devoted to your love-hate relationship with ambivalence.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I have mixed feelings about it.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Wow, the Falls of Anxiety.

Name: Falls of Anxiety
Dialog: Is my neck too long? Is it okay that I wear the same dress everyday? (The falls continues to voice Candace's anxieties)

Name: Candace
Dialog: What's that?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: It is all of Candace's anxieties.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: There are so... many of them.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: She has a rich internal life.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah, she's really messed up.

Name: Candace
Dialog: Buford?!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: What's he doin'?

Name: Irving
Dialog: He just showed up and jacked in!

Name: Candace
Dialog: You can't come in here!

Name: Buford
Dialog: It's a free country.

Name: Candace
Dialog: No it's not! It's my head! And you're getting crumbs all over-- cru... all over... cru, cru, cru--

Name: Buford
Dialog: What's wrong with her?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: The anxieties are getting to her!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hurry, everyone! Through the falls! The Palms of Sweatiness!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: The Harpies of Hyperventilation!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Rubber ducks?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Do not ask me! It is your subconscious!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah, I'll catch yous later. I'm keeping my hoagie dry.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, Buford.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey, Isabella. You just get here?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Yep.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Let me show you around. This place is a riot!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (sniffs) D-Do-Do you smell something burning? What are you doing?! Give me that! Got it! What is this, a tiny magnifying glass? Oh, you think you're so fancy with your high-tech spy equipment. (He crushes the contact lens) What are you going to do now? Huh, Perry the Platypus? Huh? (laughs) (Perry takes out the other contact lens)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Here we are Candace, the Forest of Memory.

Name: Candace
Dialog: How will we find Jeremy's gift?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, we shouldn't have to walk too far since it's a recent memory. What's the last thing you remember?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Hmm... the last thing I remember is saying, "How will we find Jeremy's gift?"

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well we shouldn't have to walk too far since it's a recent memory. What's the last thing you remember?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Oh, I forgot it already.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No problem. This should be deep enough. Everybody just feel around. Maybe we can stimulate Candace's memory.

Name: Candace
Dialog: That makes my head all buzzy. Wait, wait a minute, wait! I'm remembering! Yes, yes, I see it! Over there, through the trees! That's it!

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: That's what?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jeremy? Wait, are you real?

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Yeah. I stopped by your house to give you your present and Irving just told me to jack right in.

Name: Candace
Dialog: My present? How could you? I lost it. But I found the memory. It's right over there.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: That? That's not your present. That's my drain unclogger. I don't know why I carry that around with me.

Name: Candace
Dialog: So I didn't lose your-- (id comes in and roars)

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: It is the id! Run!

Name: Buford
Dialog: And if you follow me now, you'll see Candace's recurring nightmares. Come on, people. Try and stay with the group. (they see everyone running from the id) Hey, where are they going? (he sees the id and screams)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (as Perry escapes from the trap) It's ironic, I built my Underwear-inator while actually in my underwear. Ha! (Perry attacks him and the Underwear-inator fires up)

Name: Id
Dialog: (as children are running away from it) Clubby Momo!

Name: Buford
Dialog: You all signed the releases, right?

Name: Id
Dialog: Phineas and Ferb!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ow! (Underwear-inator hits Perry) Ha! You look ridic-- (Underwear-inator hits Doofenshmirtz) Ah! Moth holes?!

Name: Norm
Dialog: Who wants lobster bisque? (Underwear-inator hits him) Get it while it's hot!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Irving! Get us out of here now!

Name: Irving
Dialog: Roger, over! (Underwear-inator hits him) (Gasps) Lavender! Ahh! It had to be lavender! (He runs from his station)

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hello? Irving? Hello?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Curse you, Perry the Platypus! Y-Y-You know, those, those really work for you.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I cannot believe I turned down a trip to the community pool for this!

Name: Candace
Dialog: She's growing! What do we do?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: One of us has to wake up and extract the others!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I am trying to wake up, but I can't! Oh! I feel a shock!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: That's it! Let's all shock Baljeet awake with contractions!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Isn't!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Won't!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: It's! Don't!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hasn't!

Name: All
Dialog: Ain't!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: That is both a contraction and grammatically incorrect! Ahh! (he wakes up)

Name: Irving
Dialog: (running around in circles) Lavender! Had to be lavender!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: The... wires... must... pull... them... out... with... no muscles.

Name: Candace
Dialog: I don't think I can run anymore!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Don't give up! Baljeet will save us!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I'm getting tired, too!

Name: Ginger
Dialog: That's it! I'm dead meat!

Name: Gretchen
Dialog: Gretchen is out! Peace! (Candace falls, causing everyone else to fall)

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'm really complicated in here. (everyone gets eaten by the id and wakes up)

Name: Ginger
Dialog: That was great! Let's do it again!

Name: Irving
Dialog: Not me!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: I wish I had my camera!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Wait until they hear about this at psychology camp!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Goodbye, everybody!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wow, I guess that was a lot of trouble to go through for a drain unclogger.

Name: Jeremy
Dialog: Yeah, by the way, here's your real gift. (hands Candace a bracelet)

Name: Candace
Dialog: Jeremy, it's beautiful! I really really love it. Thank you. Wait, hold on. Where's Buford?

Name: Buford
Dialog: (to id) I don't care what Freud said about your selfish need for satisfaction. You're alright with me.
